regions.title: Regions
regions.intro: Cantons and cities with approval. A region is only approved once the legal and operational requirements have been checked and documented.
regions.caption: Cantons and their cities
regions.count: {cantons, plural, one {One canton} other {# cantons}}, {approved, plural, =0 {no region approved} one {one region approved} other {# regions approved}}
regions.unknownRegion: This region does not exist. Choose a region from the table.
regions.emptyDescription: Cantons and cities come from the reference data. Run the seeds to create them.
regions.rulesIntro: Whoever changes the rules substantially marks the region as checked again afterwards.
regions.legalNoteHint: What applies legally in this region, in your own words.
regions.requiredPermitsHint: For example a registration duty or a permit for providers.
regions.contentRestrictionsHint: What profiles may not show in this region.
regions.rankHint: 1 to 999; smaller numbers appear further up on the home page. Empty: not featured.
regions.checkIntro: Documents that the legal and operational requirements have been checked. Date and person appear in the table, the note in the audit log.
regions.checkNoteHint: At least 10 characters, for example source and result.
regions.needsCheck: Check the legal basis first: without a documented check the region cannot be approved.
regions.needsCanton: Approve the canton first: {canton} is not approved yet.
regions.withdrawCities: {count, plural, =0 {Withdraws the canton’s approval.} one {Also withdraws the approval of one city.} other {Also withdraws the approval of # cities.}} If you approve the canton again, each city needs its own decision.
regions.reasonHint: At least 10 characters. Goes into the audit log.
regions.approvedSaved: The region is approved. Profiles appear once the search index is updated.
regions.withdrawConfirmCanton: Profiles in this canton no longer appear in search and filters. {count, plural, =0 {No city is affected.} one {One approved city also loses its approval.} other {# approved cities also lose their approval.}}
regions.withdrawConfirmCity: Profiles in this city no longer appear in search and filters.

categories.title: Categories
categories.intro: Service categories in four languages. New categories are not approved until you approve them.
categories.caption: Categories by order
categories.createIntro: After creation the category is not approved and does not appear anywhere yet.
categories.unknown: This category does not exist. Choose one from the table.
categories.slugHint: 2 to 40 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens. Appears in addresses.
categories.orderHint: 0 to 9999; smaller numbers appear further up.
categories.approveIntro: After approval providers can choose the category, and it appears in search and filters.
categories.withdrawIntro: {count, plural, =0 {No profile uses the category.} one {One profile uses the category; it keeps it, but it no longer appears in search and filters.} other {# profiles use the category; they keep it, but it no longer appears in search and filters.}}
categories.reasonHint: At least 10 characters. Goes into the audit log.
categories.emptyDescription: Create the first category; providers choose it in their profile.
